rules: runtime WebP is a derived delivery asset and does not change badge identity
badge_id / visual_id / asset_slot_id remain stable when artwork changes
source replacement updates source SHA + revision, regenerates WebP, and rewrites only the owning shard while logical asset identity stays fixed
ownership / tier / stars / lock remain runtime UI layers and are never baked into derived artwork
each shard and every extracted WebP is SHA-256 verified before rendering
missing or corrupt shard fails closed; runtime must not invent replacement art
